subject: Copy of Newspaper Publication
detail: Amines & Plasticizers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding another Special Window which has been opened for a period of 1(One) year from February 05, 2026 to February 04, 2027 for lodgement or re-lodgement for transfer and dematerialisation of physical securities which were sold/purchased prior to April 01, 2019.
